'''Gendar's grandfather''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] who was sentenced to survive in the [[Undercity (Taris)|Undercity]] of [[Taris/Legends|Taris]]. At some point, he became the [[Outcast village|village's]] leader. He was eventually succeeded by [[Gendar's father|his son]], who was later succeeded by ''his'' son, [[Gendar]].<ref name="kotor" />
